hero.title: We explore the heart of Europe, one day at a time.
hero.subtitle: RITA Tours & Travels is an EU-registered travel studio based in the Netherlands. We craft immersive day journeys—starting right here in the Dutch and Benelux regions—connecting you with authentic food, deep local history, and a real person behind every itinerary.
hero.imageAlt: Lakeside villas and mountains on Lake Como at golden hour

story.title: Our Story: A Legacy of Wanderlust
paragraphs: Wanderlust is a seed planted in the heart, often nurtured by those we love the most. For me, that inspiration was my mom, Rita. She was a woman who profoundly loved to travel, and she wove her dreams of exploring the world into the very fabric of my soul.

Living in beautiful Netherlands, my greatest wish was to bring her here to share my world. While that dream did not unfold in the way I had hoped, 2026 marked the beginning of a new kind of journey. To honor her beautiful memory and keep her passion alive, I decided to take the immense love for travel she instilled in me and share it with fellow explorers across the globe.

Over the past eight years, my husband and I have wandered through nearly twenty countries together. Along the way, we discovered a profound truth: to truly see a European city, you must do more than simply look at its landmarks. You must taste its authentic food, listen to the echoes of its history, and embrace its vibrant culture. Only by peeling back these layers does a simple getaway transform into a lifelong memory.
This space was created to share that essence of travel with you. It is a home for those who want to look beyond the surface and experience the true heartbeat of a place.
Immerse yourself in the story of every destination. Make your story Simply Unforgettable.

heritage.title: European by registration. Local by habit.
heritage.subtitle: We are a Dutch-registered company working under EU consumer protection rules for package travel — and we build every route with the people who actually live on it.

items.title: The Spark
items.body: Our personal travel journey began. Wandering through our first European cities, we quickly learned that the best experiences happen off the beaten path.

items.title: 20 Countries Later
items.body: After years of exploring with my husband, our philosophy solidified: true travel requires immersing yourself in local food, history, and everyday culture.

items.title: A Legacy Born
items.body: Rita Tours N Travels was founded in the Netherlands to honor my mother's wanderlust and share our deeply localized way of traveling with kindred spirits.

items.title: Intentionally Small
items.body: We launch our first curated routes with a strict 50-traveler capacity, ensuring every journey feels like traveling with a knowledgeable local friend.

heritage.note: RITA Tours N Travels is registered in the Netherlands and sells package travel under EU Directive (EU) 2015/2302. Full company and financial-protection details are confirmed in every quotation.

sustainability.title: Travel beautifully. Travel with intention.
sustainability.subtitle: We would rather show you the true heartbeat of one region properly than rush you through multiple cities badly. Here is how we keep our day journeys responsible.
sustainability.imageAlt: Dolomites limestone peaks above an alpine meadow

commitments.title: Efficient road journeys
commitments.body: By relying on shared modern coaches and group transport for our day tours, we significantly lower the carbon footprint compared to guests driving individually in separate rental cars.

commitments.title: Deep local focus
commitments.body: We dedicate our day trips to thoroughly exploring one specific area, minimizing highway transit time and maximizing your time enjoying authentic food, history, and culture on foot.

commitments.title: Community first
commitments.body: From our transport drivers to family-run lunch spots, we contract directly within the community. No massive booking platforms taking margins from the locals who host us.

commitments.title: Protecting local life
commitments.body: To respect the neighborhoods we visit and actively prevent overtourism, we strictly cap our daily registrations at 50 travelers, ensuring your footprint remains small and your experience remains intimate.

sustainability.note: Group size and transport methods are designed to minimize local impact. We prioritize community well-being over volume.
